temperature.source: Gaia Collaboration (2023), Gaia Data Release 3, A&A 674, A1, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202243940; GSP-Phot astrophysical parameters (Andrae et al. 2023, A&A 674, A27, doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
temperature.query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, teff_gspphot, teff_gspphot_lower, teff_gspphot_upper, logg_gspphot, mh_gspphot FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE source_id = 3767805209112436736
temperature.note: GSP-Phot fits Gaia's BP/RP photometry, parallax and G magnitude with model atmospheres. Its lower and upper columns are the 16th and 84th percentiles and omit systematic error, which Andrae et al. (2023) find is larger for cool, metal-rich dwarfs.
